headerDisplay: Matter & HomeKit Air Conditioner (AEHA Protocol - tested on Sanyo KMHS0772)

irDevice.title: IR Transmitter Device
irDevice.description: Path to the LIRC character device used for infrared transmission.

carrierFrequency.title: Carrier Frequency (Hz)
carrierFrequency.description: Modulation carrier frequency in Hz for the IR transmitter (default: 38000).

enableMatter.title: Enable Matter Protocol
enableMatter.description: Expose this AC as a Matter RoomAirConditioner when Matter is enabled on the Homebridge bridge.

dhtSensor.title: DHT Temperature Sensor File Path
dhtSensor.description: Path to read the ambient temperature.

humiditySensor.title: DHT Humidity Sensor File Path
humiditySensor.description: Path to read the relative humidity for Steadman's Apparent Temperature calculation.

enableApparentTempAccessory.title: Enable Apparent Temperature Accessory
enableApparentTempAccessory.description: Expose a standalone Apparent Temperature & Relative Humidity sensor accessory calculated using Steadman's formula (wind speed = 0).

enableHap.title: Enable Parallel HomeKit (HAP) Accessory
enableHap.description: Also publish a classic HomeKit HeaterCooler accessory so the AC appears directly on the Homebridge UI web dashboard.

enableAuxSwitches.title: Enable Auxiliary Control Switches
enableAuxSwitches.description: Expose linked switches for Swing, Powerful, Quiet, Economy, and Ionizer under the Air Conditioner.

defaultFlapPosition.title: Default Flap Position (Non-Swing)
defaultFlapPosition.description: Flap position when Swing is off or by default.
